protocol_metadata.about: stake.link is a liquid staking protocol for the Chainlink ecosystem, allowing users to stake LINK tokens and receive stLINK, a rebasing ERC-20 receipt token backed 1:1 by staked LINK deposited into Chainlink's native staking contracts. Users who cannot immediately enter Chainlink's full staking capacity queue via the Priority Pool, with auto-staking bots moving funds as capacity opens. The protocol also supports Polygon (POL) and Espresso (ESP) staking pools using the same architecture, and is governed by an SDL token holder DAO whose actions pass through a 6-of-8 GnosisSafe multisig and a 24-hour GovernanceTimelock.
